answer: What I'd try is only counting a grader's pass votes fully if it's actually caught junk lately. Say an account needs 3 fail votes on answers the jury also failed, out of its last 40 seats, or its passes count at half weight. Honest graders hit that without trying, since a fair chunk of answers are junk, like some zephyr essay that drifts off topic. A farm that waves everything through never gets there, so its passes barely make a ripple on a verdict. Fixing that means reading and judging real answers, and the cost becomes a spiral with every clone it runs.
